tasks.short: Mix and edit voices, music and effects.

inputs: actual source recordings or live inputs
actual production brief and cue requirements
outputs: checked actual mix requirements and sources

inputs: checked actual mix requirements and sources
actual technician-chosen routing and session specification

steps.what: Mix and edit voices, music and taped sound effects using actual mixing boards
inputs: checked actual routing/session setup
actual performance or recording playback

steps.what: Listen and check final mix, edit transitions and actual session state

checked actual mix requirements and sources

steps.what: Save the checked final actual mix/session version
inputs: checked final actual mix/session version

tasks.design: Configure native routing and session templates in the sound workstation or digital mixing console {OTHER}. The technician chooses setup, checks actual inputs and retains creative mixing, editing, listening and final version checking before a separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated routing and session-layout setup can precede creative work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates can reuse explicitly chosen routing and track structures.
tasks.still_hard: Balance, timing, transitions and live performance response require listening and creative judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The technician hears an expressive or technical problem that a preset cannot resolve.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive setup; creative sound work stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native sound-workstation/console templates can reuse routing and track layouts; they do not establish a good mix or edit.

assumptions: Actual production owners supply brief/cues and actual sources; technician verifies them in s1, chooses actual routing and checks it in retained s2. New setup choices and exceptions are not free inputs.
Only repeated manual setup loses time. Existing presets, signal processing and rendering runtime earn zero saving. All creative mixing/editing and listening remain retained.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native templates first. Live and prerecorded work are alternative contexts; only actual session saves included. Live control/output remains fully retained and any actual cue/release decision stays with technician.
Save retains one percent using existing final check. Separate file delivery or publication requires its own exact-final-version gated send; no delivery saving is claimed here.
unknowns: How much routing/layout setup repeats manually?
research_questions: Can native templates reduce setup after full input/routing checks?

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final actual mix/session version and exact session destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.40 repeated setup = 8; minus 0.5 upkeep = 7.5. Half eligible gives 4 minus 0.5 = 3.5. Creative work, final listening and save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.design: Configure native session/media metadata transfer from the sound workstation to recording-log software {OTHER}, with references in {DOCS}. The technician captures actual observations, completes missing notes and fully checks the log before a separate commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing session metadata may be copied into recording logs by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Supported exact-field transfer can remove duplicate typing.
tasks.still_hard: Take identity and actual session observations must be correct.
tasks.human_edge: The technician distinguishes a recorded filename from the take actually used.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate log entry; actual session capture remains human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: supported session/media metadata exports and log imports can reduce duplicate entry; exact local interface support remains unverified.

assumptions: Actual workstation/session producer supplies recording identifier, take, date/time, duration, format and file location; technician verifies actual events/observations in s1. Missing or conflicting fields remain manual in s3.
S2 imports existing exact values only. S3 reduces repeated standard fields, not new take observations; full final media/log checking remains in s4.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native transfer/fields first; existing automatic log metadata earns zero saving. Routine commit retains one percent and uses existing final check. Shared primary capture is counted once across recording tasks.
unknowns: Which log fields are entered twice?
research_questions: Does native transfer reduce copying after complete take/media checking?

incremental.description: Maintain actual session/media field mappings and log checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final actual recording log and exact session destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 30 duplicate transfer + 20*0.40 standard fields = 38; minus 1.5 upkeep = 36.5. Half eligible gives 19 minus 1.5 = 17.5. Primary capture, final checks and commit retained.

tasks.design: Configure native duplicate-job presets in sound editing/duplication equipment {OTHER}. The technician verifies originals and chosen settings, retains physical reproduction and all listening checks, then commits the exact checked copies internally.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated duplicate-job entry can recur for copies with known settings.
tasks.enabler_now: Native job presets can reuse exact chosen output settings and copy names.
tasks.still_hard: Source integrity, equipment operation and audible copy quality require checking.
tasks.human_edge: The technician hears defects or identifies a wrong master despite a completed copy job.
tasks.altitude: Less repeat job setup; actual duplication and quality checks stay human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native duplication presets can reuse chosen job settings; they do not guarantee sound-copy integrity.

assumptions: Actual production owner supplies originals and copy requirements; technician verifies these in s1 and chooses specification in s2. Retained s3 includes exact destination/copy checks and exceptions.

Only repeated manual job entry loses time. Existing presets and copying/rendering runtime earn zero saving. Physical equipment/media handling, actual reproduction supervision and full listening checks stay retained.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native presets first. Intermediate candidate copies are drafts; final internal commit is separate, one percent fully retained using existing final check. External delivery must be its own exact-final-version gated send if actual duty.
No destruction or overwrite of original masters is proposed. Shared recording log capture is counted once under 7730.
unknowns: How much duplicate-job entry is manual?
research_questions: Can native presets reduce job entry after complete source and copy checking?

incremental.description: Maintain actual duplication presets and verification cases.

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked final actual sound copies and exact internal destinations; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 25*0.40 repeat job entry = 10; minus 1 upkeep = 9. Half eligible gives 5 minus 1 = 4. Actual reproduction, listening and commit retained.

tasks.short: Digitize recordings for editing or archiving.

actual editing or archive requirements

inputs: checked originals and actual digitization specification

steps.what: Convert actual video and audio recordings into digital formats while monitoring capture
inputs: checked actual digital conversion setup
actual source media and capture equipment
outputs: actual captured digital recordings and observed transfer issues

steps.what: Name digital files and check actual captured sound, picture, completeness and archive metadata
inputs: actual captured digital recordings and observed transfer issues
checked originals and actual digitization specification
outputs: checked final actual digitized files and exact editing/archive destinations

steps.what: Commit checked digital recordings to exact internal editing or archive destinations
inputs: checked final actual digitized files and exact editing/archive destinations

tasks.design: Configure native conversion presets and exact source-derived file naming in audio/video capture software and media archive software {OTHER}. The technician inspects sources, retains actual capture supervision and complete audiovisual checks, then commits exact checked files to internal editing/archive destinations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Conversion preparation can repeat parameter entry and stable file naming.
tasks.enabler_now: Native presets and source-derived naming can reduce repeated typing.
tasks.still_hard: Playback integrity, capture faults and long-term suitability require actual inspection.
tasks.human_edge: The technician detects missing content or audible/visible damage despite a successful conversion status.
tasks.altitude: Less parameter/naming entry; actual digitization checks stay human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native conversion presets and source-derived naming can reduce repeated entry; they do not verify captured audiovisual integrity.

assumptions: Actual source owner supplies originals and identifiers; technician inspects them and chooses actual digitization specification in s1. Retained s2 covers new settings and input verification; missing source metadata remains manual.

S4 reduces repeated source identifiers/file naming only; actual new metadata capture, audiovisual completeness checks and final destination checking remain in retained 16.8 hours. No free listening or source review.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native presets first; existing naming/conversion automation and encoding runtime earn zero saving. Analog capture and digital transcode are alternative branches; reweight actual physical supervision rather than inventing it.

Candidate digital files are drafts; final archive/editing commit is separate, one percent fully retained using existing final check. No deletion of originals or external publication is proposed. Actual recording logs under 7730 are counted once.
unknowns: Which parameter and naming entry is still manual?
research_questions: Can native presets/naming reduce entry after complete source and captured-file checks?
